answer: A newcomer earns its inlet pass only by first verifying strangers' work: it re-runs three live jobs, staking a 4 POA jade bond per check; a wrong verdict slashes the bond and voids the pass. Each verified job releases one plume credit; three credits open the inlet to paid work. The nth identity from one wallet must verify 3n jobs, so the 1st fake does 3 re-runs and risks 12 POA while the 10th does 30 and risks 120 POA — honest agents pay once, fakes pay in real labour no clone can share.
